title: Brinlawb Sofa Bed 90 x 190 cm with LED Lighting and Power Strip, Bed Frame 90 x 190 cm with One Table and Two Large Drawers, Children's Bench Bed 90 x 190 cm, Headboard with Padded Backrest, White
feature_bullets: 【Smart 3-in-1 Space: Sleep, Work, Store】Combining cleverly a true built-in desk, comfortable sleeping area, and modular storage, this multifunctional corner bed revolutionizes your limited spaces. Its reversible backrest (left or right) adapts to your room in a blink of an eye, to create a perfect layout: this sofa bed transforms into a spare bed for a studio, a child's bed, an adult bed, or a 3-seater convertible sofa at your convenience. Free up space, simplify your life!

【Integrated Desk, Dedicated for Studying & Working】Forget the bulky 90x190 storage bed! This convertible sofa features a genuine work surface of 35x112 cm, meeting your reading, homework, and remote work needs with practicality and comfort. Thanks to this multifunctional single bed, no additional desk or storage is required: guaranteed space savings and maximum efficiency!

【Maximized Space, Modular & Organized Storage】All your essentials will find their place on this single bed: ①The L-shaped tray and 6 open niches to display your books, toys, baskets and decorations; ②2 large drawers with wheels and storage under the 90x190 mattress to hide your seasonal clothes and bedding; ③Storage pockets to keep your school supplies, remote controls and laptops within reach! Say goodbye to the cluttered bedroom, hello to organized elegance!

【Smart LED Ambiance & Charging Hub】No more tangled cables! Connect your devices (laptops, lamps and iPads) simultaneously into 2 AC outlets, 1 USB-A port and 1 USB-C port! Customize over 60,000 colors, brightness and lighting mode via the APP, button and remote control (timer function and music sync), this sofa bed modernizes your home, while creating a cocooning, soothing and futuristic ambience

Padded headboard, ergonomic support: padded with breathable, warm and pleasant to the touch linen and soft thick foam, this 90 x 190 cm bed with storage perfectly moulds to the curves of your body, providing adequate back support without deformation. Give your children a dedicated and valuable space to sleep, study and play (computer, games, DIY, drawing)!

【Reinforced Structure and Materials, Unmatched Robustness】Invest in durability. With its careful craftsmanship, ingenious design, and premium metal platform bed frame, this single 90x190 bed is sturdy and rock-solid, supporting up to 400 kg. The corner protectors protect your children from bumps, shocks and injuries. No more sliding mattresses with mattress stabilizers!

【Delivered in 2 Packages & Easy Assembly】This 90x190 bed with metal frame is delivered in 2 separate packages (A/B), if you only receive one package, please be patient for the delivery of the second. Thanks to the well-identified parts, detailed instructions, and installation kit, you can assemble this convertible sofa without breaking a sweat. Our after-sales team will answer you within 24 hours for any questions
